# Stone Heritage Mukteshwar
Last updated: 2026-07-31

> Authentic Kumaoni heritage homestay in Mukteshwar, Uttarakhand. Premier mountain retreat featuring panoramic Himalayan Nanda Devi peak views, authentic stone architecture, homemade vegetarian Kumaoni dining, high-speed optical fiber WiFi, and 100% pet-friendly stone cottages.

## 2. Room Categories & Accommodations
Stone Heritage offers 9 unique room and suite configurations built with local stone and wood:
- **Stonewood Family Retreat:** Luxury family suite featuring 2 King Beds, spacious living area, private balcony, and panoramic Himalayan mountain views. Ideal for 4-6 guests.
- **Copper Room:** Premium room featuring 1 King Bed and 1 Single Bed, garden view, suitable for up to 4 guests.
- **Brass Room:** King Bed room with mountain view, en-suite bathroom.
- **The Vintage Room:** Classic Kumaoni heritage room featuring 1 King Bed, valley view, stone-carved architecture.
- **Stone and Story Suite:** Boutique suite featuring 1 King Bed, mountain view, premium interior.
- **Iron Room:** King Bed room with garden view, en-suite bathroom.
- **Cedar Room:** King Bed room with forest view, wooden paneling, ideal for solo travelers.
- **Himalayan Workation:** Dedicated workstation setup with high-speed Wi-Fi and Himalayan view, designed for remote work stays.
- **Stone Cottage Room:** King Bed with private terrace balcony, sunset and mountain views, ideal for couples or small families.

## 3. Key Amenities & Guest Features
- **Unobstructed Mountain Views:** Direct sunrise and sunset views of the snow-capped Nanda Devi Himalayan range.
- **Authentic Kumaoni Dining:** Freshly cooked vegetarian meals prepared with locally sourced organic ingredients.
- **Workcation Ready:** Dedicated high-speed optical fiber WiFi (100+ Mbps) and power backup.
- **100% Pet-Friendly:** Private gardens and open green lawns welcoming dogs and pets of all sizes, with prepared pet meals available on request.
- **Bonfire & BBQ Nights:** Evening outdoor campfire setups and stargazing experiences under clear mountain skies.

- **Bhatelia Market:** 3 km (~5 mins drive)

- **Kainchi Dham (Neem Karoli Baba Ashram):** 32 km (~1 hr drive)
- **Bhimtal Lake:** 35 km (~1 hr 15 mins drive)

- **Kathgodam Railway Station (KGM):** 62 km (~2 hrs drive)
